title: How to Store and Clean Your PVC Figures
excerpt: A few simple habits will keep your collection looking display-case-fresh for years — here's what actually matters.
content:
PVC figures are durable, but sunlight, dust, and heat are the three things that age them fastest.

Keep figures out of direct sunlight — UV exposure is the #1 cause of yellowing and color fade over time.

Dust with a soft, dry brush (a makeup brush works great) rather than cloth, which can scratch glossy paint.

Avoid humid or very hot rooms; extreme heat can warp joints and soften glued parts.

If a figure came with a display case or box, keeping it boxed when not on display is the single best way to preserve value for collectors who plan to resell later.

title: Pre-order Price Guarantee at wfigure
excerpt: Reserve early with confidence — if the price drops before release, you pay the lower price.
content:
When you place a pre-order, the manufacturer's listed price can sometimes change before the figure actually ships months later.

At wfigure, if the official retail price drops before your pre-order arrives, you'll automatically be charged the new, lower price — no need to cancel and re-order.

If the price goes up instead, you still pay the price you locked in when you ordered.

This policy applies to all pre-order and order items marked on the product page, and is one more reason to reserve early instead of waiting for general release.
